name: markify
description: Convert web pages to Obsidian-formatted Markdown with YAML frontmatter

scripts.test: bun run --filter @markify/core test && bun run --filter @markify/userscript test
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter @markify/core build && bun run --filter "@markify/*" typecheck
scripts.validate: bun run test && bun run typecheck && bun run build
